comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7c97127, the head of the repository. Six commits carry version 2.1.0 and four of them change the source, so the build was settled twice over: the controller-number table at commit 8e2251e swapped two blocks of CC numbers, and the installed build carries the swapped table (36,37,39,40,41,45,46,47,48,49,50,51,58,59 and 12,5,15,16,14,81,4,8,79,80,82,83,20,21), which rules out everything before it; and commit 7c97127 moved the font load out of the display widgets' constructors into their draw methods, and in the installed build the only two calls to Window::loadFont sit inside DisplayWidget::draw and VerySmallDisplayWidget::draw, with neither constructor calling it. That is the head. Three faults. The save button dereferences the file chooser's result before testing it for null (std::string pathStr = path, with the if (path) test on the line after), so cancelling the Save dialog constructs a std::string from a null pointer and takes Rack down with it; the load button has the same code with the test in the right place. The module declares a MOD_SOURCE1 parameter whose addParam call is commented out in the widget, so it has a ParamQuantity, occupies parameter index 76 and can never be clicked or turned - it gets no line here for that reason. And every controller parameter is configured 0 to 128 while the value sent is clamped to 0 to 127, so the last step of every slider's travel sends nothing new. The controller numbers in the lines are read straight from the nymphes_cc_map table and the index arithmetic that reaches it (learnedCcs[j+44] for the twenty-eight main controls and the reverb, LFO 2, wheel and volume ones, learnedCcs[i+8] for the thirty-six modulation depths). The fourth oscillator slider is lettered chord on the MOD panel and left blank on the main panel; it carries controller 16 there, which is the same control, so both lines name it chord. Sending is throttled by a 0.0005 second rate limiter and a further count of twenty passes between messages.
